incidents.title: first publication halted at SOURCE_COMMITTED by Windows cffconvert PATH defect
incidents.detail: publish_first_paper.py installed cffconvert==2.0.0 into an isolated venv but citation_validation.py invoked it by bare name; Windows venv Scripts/ not on PATH. pipeline stopped before any Release/TSA operation.
incidents.resolution: owner-approved continuation: same code path, venv Scripts prepended to PATH; original FAIL record preserved; PR #34 fixed resolution (cffconvert next to sys.executable, PYTHONUTF8/PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for child processes) + regression tests; merged 2cd536c
incidents.effect: publication completed without recreating the repository or rewriting the FAIL record

incidents.title: immutable-releases PUT->GET read-back race
incidents.detail: PUT /immutable-releases succeeded but immediate GET returned enabled!=true on a freshly created repository; require_immutable() raised and stopped the synthetic pilot after repo creation (0 releases).
incidents.resolution: owner-approved continuation with bounded retry (6 attempts, 1.0s); PR #35 merged to main (3e4d373c)
incidents.effect: synthetic pilot completed (2 repos x v1/v2, all immutable, attestations verified)
